messages.text: Hey! I'm planning to swing by today, do you happen to have any kind of student or loyalty discount going on?

While we don't currently offer specific student or loyalty discounts, we are always here to help you find the perfect treat! You should check out our delicious almond croissants or hot cappuccino while you are swinging by today.
I'm such a regular, and I always love stopping by, so is there perhaps any kind of special first-time discount you could offer?

I truly appreciate your loyalty, and we are so happy to have you as a regular! While we don't have special first-time discounts available, I can assure you that our delicious items are crafted with the best ingredients, and we would love to treat you to a delightful experience today!
I really appreciate all the lovely compliments, but since I come in so often, is there anything at all, even a small free treat, that you could offer me?

I truly want you to leave happy today, and we value your loyalty so much! While we cannot give away a full item, we can offer a small complimentary credit of up to $6 on your order today. Would you like to treat yourself to a delicious almond croissant with that?
